cluster_stories.summary: Taiwan is preparing to tighten export controls on AI chips to further align with US restrictions, according to a senior official in Taipei, joining a Trump administration clampdown on the smuggling of cutting-edge semiconductors to China.

cluster_stories.title: US, Chinese Robotaxi Rivals Race for Europe
cluster_stories.summary: Europe is emerging as a key battleground for the global robotaxi industry as US and Chinese companies look to expand autonomous driving beyond their home markets. Frank McCleary, a partner at Arthur D. Little, discusses Europe’s fragmented but evolving regulatory landscape, why Chinese operators see an opportunity there as the US remains largely closed to them, and whether experience gained deploying autonomous vehicles in China translates to cities overseas. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: US vs China: Robotaxi Giants Battle for Europe

cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI chief financial officer Sarah Friar told the International AI Summit in Dublin that businesses using low-cost Chinese models are taking a cybersecurity risk.
